description: The file defines an ApiClient class for making HTTP requests (GET and POST) to a backend API, handling JSON encoding/decoding, and error handling. It also defines a custom ApiException class for error responses.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A lightweight HTTP client for interacting with a backend service using configurable base URL, supporting GET and POST requests with JSON handling.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling non-2xx HTTP responses with error messages.

methods.name: ApiClient
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the API client, with optional custom HTTP client.

methods.name: _normalizeBaseUrl
methods.description: Static method to normalize the base URL by removing trailing slash.

methods.name: _buildUri
methods.description: Builds a full URI given a path and optional query parameters.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified path with optional query parameters and returns decoded JSON.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with JSON body to the specified path with optional query parameters and returns decoded JSON.

methods.name: _handleResponse
methods.description: Handles the HTTP response, decoding JSON on success, or throwing an ApiException on error.

methods.name: _extractErrorMessage
methods.description: Attempts to extract an error message from the response body.
